title: Point Dataclass
prompt: Define a dataclass Point with float fields x and y. Two points with the same coordinates must be equal, and repr(Point(1, 2)) must contain 'Point' and the values.

tests.name: equality by fields
tests.code:
assert Point(1.0, 2.0) == Point(1.0, 2.0)
assert Point(1.0, 2.0) != Point(2.0, 1.0)

tests.name: repr is useful
tests.code:
r = repr(Point(1.0, 2.0))
assert 'Point' in r and '1.0' in r
tests.hint: The generated __repr__ shows the class name and fields.
